title: 第2章 师兄走好
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
“咕~咕~”

    李构的嘴里不断冒着血泡，丹田破碎的剧烈痛处使得他面庞扭曲，却又说不出话来，唯有一双眼睛在喷火，狠厉、不甘、惊恐兼具。

    若是眼神可以杀人，估计他已经将面前曾视作废物的苏牧千刀万剐了。

    苏牧却伸手捏着他的下颌，往其嘴里塞丹药，竟似要救人。

    “师兄莫慌。”

    “割了喉，救治及时还能活。”

    “丹田破了也不要紧，将来我为你寻来神药，定可再入仙途，重回巅峰。”

    “哎~你说你，就那么点事，何至于生死相向？”

    闻言，李构愣在当场，随即眼中浮现希冀之色，眼珠子转个不停。

    “别激动，捂紧了。”苏牧嘴角勾起一抹笑意，伸手到其背部，运起功法帮助炼化药力，边碎碎念说起往事。

    “你我认识也有七八年了吧。”

    “当初你入门，还是我给你安排的寝室，讲解宗门规矩。”

    “你资质好，发达了，偶尔些许刁难，我都没放在心上，也不敢放在心上。”

    “昨日下午你当着那么多人的面，欺我辱我，我是不是逆来顺受？”

    “我一个五灵根的窝囊废，十五年修为停滞不前，平日里谨小慎微，不敢慢待任何人，不过是留在宗门苟延残喘，混吃等死。”

    “我的处世为人，你都知道的啊。”

    “今日这般场面，我也是被逼无奈，李师兄千万莫要怪罪啊。”

    “……”

    一番话听得李构感动不已，几欲热泪盈眶，心中直呼：“苏师弟，不，苏师兄，你是个好人！”

    苏牧一顿操作简单处理好其伤势，拍拍手起身道：“好了，死不了，委屈师兄在储物袋里待会儿。”

    见李构红着眼眶微微点头，他笑了笑，从对方腰间摘下储物袋和灵兽袋，将人装进自己的储物袋。

    跟着，苏牧翻手取出一张传讯符，掐诀凝聚文字发消息，得到回复后，又将现场痕迹收拾干净，这才施展身法往库房的方向去。

    待他赶回库房所在时，门口已有一身型魁梧的男子立在墙根下等待，却是好兄弟楚阳，筑基三层的内门弟子。

    四目相对，苏牧加快脚步，上前开门，将人引到屋内。

    一直进入存放物资的石室，楚阳挥手布下隔绝屏障，看了看对方略显发白的脸庞，忙问：“大哥，出什么事了？你没事吧？”

    苏牧挤出一丝笑意道：“无妨，催动【破法锥】消耗了点元气，吃过丹药了，你怎么来得这么快，路上遇到人没？”

    楚阳却是知道【破法锥】，是件一阶极品法器，当初还是自己送给对方的。

    “传讯时我在宗门坊市，一路赶过来的，大哥放心，这么晚了少有人走动，外门又都是些低阶弟子，我刻意隐匿潜行，无人发现。”
content_en:
"Gu~gu~"

    Li Gou's mouth kept bubbling with blood, and the sharp pain from his broken Dantian made his face distorted, but he was speechless. Only his eyes were spitting fire, fierce, unwilling, and frightened.

    If looks could kill, he would have already cut Su Mu, who was once regarded as a waste, to death with a thousand knives.

    However, Su Mu reached out and pinched his chin, stuffing pills into his mouth, as if he wanted to save him.

    "Brother, don't panic."

    "If you cut your throat, you can still survive if you receive prompt treatment."

    "It doesn't matter if your Dantian is broken. In the future, I will find the magic medicine for you, and you will be able to enter the path of immortality again and return to the top."

    "Hey~ You said you, just such a little thing, how can it lead to life and death?"

    Hearing this, Li Gou was stunned on the spot, and then a look of hope appeared in his eyes, and his eyes kept turning.

    "Don't get excited, keep it tight." A smile appeared at the corner of Su Mu's mouth, and he reached out to his back, using his skills to help refine the medicine, while talking about the past.

    "You and I have known each other for seven or eight years."

    "When you first started, I arranged the dormitory for you and explained the sect's rules."

    "You are well qualified and developed, but I don't even take it to heart if you occasionally make things difficult for you, and I don't dare to take it to heart."

    "Yesterday afternoon you bullied me and humiliated me in front of so many people. Am I going to accept it?"

    "I am a useless person with five spiritual roots. My cultivation has been stagnant for fifteen years. I am usually very cautious and do not dare to be rude to anyone. I just stay in the sect and linger on, eating and waiting to die."

    "You all know how I behave."

    "In today's situation, I was forced to do nothing. Senior Brother Li must not be blamed."

    "..."

    Hearing these words, Li Gou was so moved that he almost burst into tears. He shouted in his heart: "Junior Brother Su, no, Senior Brother Su, you are a good person!"

    Su Mu treated his injuries with a simple operation, clapped his hands and stood up and said, "Okay, I can't die. I'll put the wronged brother in the storage bag for a while."

    Seeing Li Gou's red eyes and nodding slightly, he smiled, took off the storage bag and spirit animal bag from the other party's waist, and put the person into his own storage bag.

    Then, Su Mu turned over his hand and took out a communication talisman. He composed the words to send a message. After getting the reply, he cleaned up the traces of the scene and then used his skills to go to the warehouse.

    When he rushed back to the warehouse, there was a burly man waiting under the wall at the door. It was his good brother Chu Yang, an inner disciple of the third floor of the Foundation.

    Their eyes met, Su Mu quickened his pace, stepped forward to open the door, and led people into the house.

    After entering the stone room where supplies were stored, Chu Yang waved his hand to set up an isolation barrier. He looked at the other party's slightly pale face and asked hurriedly: "Brother, what happened? Are you okay?"

    Su Mu squeezed out a smile and said: "It doesn't matter. I used up some energy by activating the [Breaking Cone] and took the pill. Why did you come so fast? Did you meet anyone on the way?"

    But Chu Yang knew that the [Magic Breaking Cone] was a top-grade first-class magic weapon, and he had given it to him as a gift.

    "I was in Zongmenfang City at the time of the summons. I came all the way here. Brother, don't worry. It's so late and few people are walking around. The outer sects are all low-level disciples. I deliberately concealed myself so that no one would notice me."
